style_reference: Mekanism 1.21.1-10.7.19.85: white induction_casing, induction_port, induction_port_output; observed palette and proportions in art/reference/mekanism-textures.png
controller: Create a NEW original Minecraft WHITE induction-casing factory controller texture atlas, exactly equal 2x2 grid with divider at the exact midpoint, no margin outside the tiles, opaque background. Strict authentic Minecraft 16x16 logical pixel art per tile, overall logical 32x32. Every tile over 85 percent pale matte WHITE #cccccc to #d6d6d6 with a THIN one-pixel light-gray #aaaaaa rim, faint tiny corner joints. This is inspired by Mekanism's WHITE induction matrix casing, NOT dark Mek machine bodies. TOP LEFT idle front: white plate with a small centered recessed dark-gray rectangular 6x4 logical-pixel control socket, one gray contact pattern inside and TWO small dim green indicator pixels. TOP RIGHT top: same white casing with only two very short one-pixel light-gray recessed cooling slits, keep overwhelmingly white. BOTTOM LEFT side/back: white plate, faint corner joints, one thin light-gray vertical assembly seam. BOTTOM RIGHT active front: exact same casing, socket and indicator positions as top left, the ONLY difference is the same two indicator pixels become bright green. Do not shift any geometry. Use flat hard-edged squares. Do NOT use chunky bolts, silver stepped bevels, thick dark borders, big black panels, textured steel, gradients, bloom, screws, diagonal perspective, text, large colored displays or sci-fi framing. Minimal, clean, unmistakable white induction matrix material.
structure: Create a NEW original Minecraft texture atlas inspired specifically by the WHITE Mekanism induction matrix casing, NOT the dark steel machine casing. Exact 2x2 equal square tiles, fully opaque, no margin, no letters, no perspective. Each tile is exactly a 16x16 logical grid of coarse square pixels enlarged cleanly. Over 90 percent of every tile is PALE WHITE (#c8c8c8 to #d4d4d4); use a single thin LIGHT GRAY (#aaa) outer rim and barely visible #bbb corner joints. Do not use dark metal borders, chunky bolts, X/H braces, thick silver rims, layered bevels, exposed pipes, gradients or gritty textures. Minecraft vanilla simplicity, flat colors. TOP LEFT: unformed white modular casing with four small light-gray corner joints and one subtle narrow assembly seam. TOP RIGHT: formed white induction-style casing, a very clean broad off-white plate, ONE pixel light-gray outside edge, tiny low-contrast corner joints, no central black panel and no vents. BOTTOM LEFT: white energy cell face, same overwhelmingly white casing with one SMALL centered 4x4 dark-gray socket and two tiny green lights. BOTTOM RIGHT: white provider face, same casing, small centered dark-gray 4x4 socket with two tiny amber contacts. All faces must look like blocks built from the SAME white material used by Mekanism's induction matrix. Color belongs only in tiny functional points; white dominates. No text or arrows or lightning glyphs. No generic dark sci-fi style.
ports: Create a NEW original Minecraft texture atlas based on the WHITE Mekanism induction matrix casing. EXACT equal 2x2 grid, four opaque square 16x16 logical pixel block textures, overall 32x32 logical grid. No margin, no labels. All four tiles share the SAME nearly all-white plate: pale matte white #cccccc to #d6d6d6, ONE thin light-gray #aaaaaa outer rim, faint corner joints. TOP LEFT unformed INPUT port: small dark-gray square socket occupying only the central 4x4 logical pixels, with a RED 1x1 logical-pixel indicator on the left and right; a faint vertical gray assembly seam. TOP RIGHT unformed OUTPUT port: identical socket and gray seam, BLUE indicators instead. BOTTOM LEFT formed INPUT port: same socket and red indicators, now a clean unbroken white plate without the assembly seam. BOTTOM RIGHT formed OUTPUT port: same clean white plate and blue indicators. Very minimal, just like a Mek induction port on its white casing. At least 90% WHITE/light gray. Colored lights must be large enough to survive exact 16x16 reduction: each is ONE FULL logical pixel, not subpixel. NO big colored rings or arrows, NO heavy borders, NO shiny silver or layered bevels, NO screws, NO black machine casing, NO gradients, NO soft shading or realistic lighting, NO fancy sci-fi patterns. Crisp flat Minecraft pixel art.
